target: an artifact, by locator (may refine below a file)
scope: artifacts the registry curates; authoritative for what it covers, undeclared is a normal state
title: Content classification
gloss: What each artifact is epistemically: supplied source material, mechanical output, or authored analysis, and which corpora it belongs to.

scope: every .md and .json file under docs/ (the gate walks those two extensions; docs/examples/, docs/prototypes/ and docs/favicons/ hold four other files, out of scope and deliberately so)
title: Documentation inventory
gloss: Every document under docs/, what it is about, whether it is kept true, and who can reach it.

scope: code files under tools/ and scripts/, except tools/test/, which the tests census owns
title: Harness inventory
gloss: Every code file under tools/ and scripts/, what it is for, how it is invoked, and whether prose names it or a test exercises it.

scope: every key in use across the estate's repo manifests, INCLUDING the members of an array or object key, addressed pages[].path or stage.files. Those were nested inside their parent rows until 2026-08-16, so the census counted 20 while its scope claimed 46
title: Manifest field vocabulary
gloss: Every key a repo's .web-tools.json may carry, what it means, which tool reads it, and whether a member is required

target: a repeated statement, or a scope for a family rule
scope: Statements the hub's own coordination layer repeats: the portable set, the conventions text, skills, adoption, toss routes, showing mechanisms, measured environment facts, and the code layers. NOT the content documents, whose one-owner question is the docs census's. The denominator is docs/ plus the skills, which is why eleven rows is a population and not a sample.
title: Statement ownership
gloss: For a statement the coordination layer repeats, which carrier is authoritative and how every other mention relates to it.

scope: every .html page under pages/, arranged into groups; the group wrapper (label, top) is structure rather than assertions about a page, the same standing as a carrier note block
title: Page gallery
gloss: Every HTML page under pages/, grouped, with the title and thumbnail the gallery and picker show.

scope: files curated to travel to other repos; an authored selection crosswalk over the censuses that own each target, so intrinsic description is inherited rather than restated
title: To-go set
gloss: The files that travel to other repos, and how a consumer takes each one.

scope: the ways toss-render.html is handed a payload or a reference, and the trust posture each buys
title: Delivery modes
gloss: How a tossed payload travels, and the trust and sandbox posture each mode carries.

scope: the content types that map to a renderer page; owner of toss-render.html's inlined TOSS_ROUTES literal
title: Renderer dispatch table
gloss: Every route toss-render accepts, what each one addresses, and which viewer it opens.

scope: the links that can show a change, what each reaches and misses; rendered as the Map view Showing tab
title: Showing mechanisms
gloss: Which link reaches which kind of change, and what each one silently misses.

scope: every directory under skills/
title: Skill roster
gloss: The skills this repo ships, each carrying the trigger description its own SKILL.md owns.

scope: the primitives SURFACING.md defines. The PROSE stays authoritative and this is its gated index, so ownership runs opposite to every other registry here; declaring its fields governs the INDEX, not the definitions
title: Surfacing primitives
gloss: The gated index of SURFACING.md’s primitives, the prose staying authoritative.

scope: every .mjs under tools/test/ except the declared shared helpers
title: Test coverage map
gloss: Every check in the suite, what kind it is, and what breaks if it is deleted.

scope: the names a prose-bearing CSV column or JSON key may carry, estate-wide; portable, since a concept named once should be the same concept in every repo
title: Prose field vocabulary
gloss: The sanctioned names for a prose-bearing field, so one concept is not called four things across four carriers.

scope: pages the Tools view shelves; a crosswalk over pages-catalog, which owns each page's title and description. Every bare hub path must resolve to a row in pages/pages.json
title: Tools shelf
gloss: The authored selection of pages the Tools view shows, and the icon each is given; a crosswalk over the page gallery.

scope: every task file under tracker/tasks/
title: Tracker board
gloss: Every task in the project tracker, its state, size, and activity, derived from the task files.

scope: the ?view= keys show-repo.html's VIEWS table dispatches, and the files that render each; not toss routes, which are a content type mapped to a renderer page and answer to routes-routes
title: App route inventory
gloss: Every destination the show-repo app can be sent to, what it is for, and which files draw it.

scope: registries the estate declares. Curated, not computed: no rule decides whether a file is a registry, which is why this table missed itself and .paths.json
title: Registries
gloss: every registry the estate declares: where it lives, what it asserts about, and what holds it

target: a property one registry records about its targets
scope: every column of every registry in registries.csv, except each registry's key, which is the row's identity rather than a fact about it
title: Properties
gloss: every column of every registry: what it means, how it arises, and what it may hold

target: one repetition of a statement, somewhere other than its owner
scope: every place a registered statement is said again; curated alongside owners.csv, which names the statement
title: Statement repetitions
gloss: for each statement the coordination layer repeats, where the copy sits, how it relates, and what holds it
